say.speaker: smoliv
say.text: Stay back! Please, I only have berry oil in my basket!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Hold steady, little Smoliv! Before we charge in, {lord}, take a moment in Battle Prep.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Now that I am fighting alongside you, use Battle Prep before each clash to choose who deploys, View Map to swap starting spots, and organize everyone's moves and items!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Mind my veteran restraint too: if I take every knockout myself, you youngsters will miss out on vital battle experience. Let me soften tough foes while you finish them!
